prompt_en: tall ghostly woman with floor-length black hair, pale grey skin and a long white embroidered gown, thorny bark-like growths and vines crawling up her back, standing beneath a giant ceiba tree
nota: Bajo la ceiba atrae con belleza falsa; su espalda de espinas delata el engaño.

prompt_en: shape-shifting spirit caught mid-transformation, human torso with a spotted jaguar head, bat-wing ears, jade bead collar, glowing amber eyes, long curved claws, wisps of green mist curling around its legs
nota: Clase de espíritus-animal de hechiceros mayas; relleno en grupos con pieles distintas.

prompt_en: colossal giant whose body is layered grey rock and moss, boulder-like fists, a head shaped like a rough mountain peak, glowing orange eyes, small pine trees growing on his shoulders
nota: Gigante que levanta montañas; cae atraído por un cangrejo falso bajo una montaña.

prompt_en: giant macaw-headed bird lord with scarlet, blue and yellow feathers, a huge hooked beak full of gleaming gem-like teeth, silver and gold rings around his eyes, broad wings, jade collar
nota: Jefe vanidoso: sus dientes de gema y su mandíbula son los puntos débiles.

prompt_en: colossal feathered serpent with sea-green and emerald quetzal plumes along its coiling body, turquoise and gold scales, a crest of long tail feathers, jade-green eyes, water spray swirling around its coils
nota: Versión quiché de Quetzalcóatl; dios creador, apto como PNJ o jefe respetuoso.

prompt_en: colossal crocodile with a moss-covered earthen back sprouting small trees and stone slabs, jagged dark-green scales, huge toothy jaws, floodwater pouring from its mouth, amber slit eyes
nota: Cocodrilo cósmico: sus heridas inundan la arena; hay que pelear sobre su lomo.

prompt_en: shaggy dog-like spirit the size of a calf, goat hooves, thick matted silver-grey fur, a long beard under the chin, glowing red eyes, pale mist around its paws on a moonlit road
nota: Base de los Cadejos blanco y negro; el aullido avisa y huye al amanecer.

prompt_en: weeping ghostly woman in a long tattered white gown and veil, pale grey face with hollow dark eyes, long black hair dripping river water, floating above the water with trailing mist
nota: Su lamento aturde de lejos; solo la postura serena de iaidō lo resiste.

prompt_en: hunched reptilian creature about four feet tall, grey-green scaly skin, a row of sharp spines down its back, large red slanted eyes, long clawed fingers, fanged mouth, powerful hind legs
nota: Críptido de 1995 en Puerto Rico; ataca de noche al ganado y huye veloz.

prompt_en: slender mountain spirit shaped like a woman with indigo-blue skin, floor-length black hair draped like a cloak, feet turned backwards, large dark eyes, standing at a moonlit cave mouth
nota: Sus pies al revés engañan al rastreo; Akira debe leer el rastro, no seguirlo.

prompt_en: ghostly woman in a long white dress seen from behind, long black hair, turning to reveal a horse-like skull face with long yellow teeth, wet clothes, standing in a shallow river
nota: Bella de espaldas, rostro de caballo al girar; el aviso falso no hace daño.

prompt_en: tiny wizened sprite knee-high with a huge wide-brimmed straw hat, pointed ears, backward-turned feet, ragged brown clothes, long thin fingers, mischievous grin and glinting eyes
nota: De origen ibérico; en Centroamérica enreda crines y desorienta caminantes.

prompt_en: huge shaggy ape-man covered in dark brown matted hair, broad shoulders, long arms nearly touching the ground, flat face with deep-set glowing eyes, feet turned backwards, standing at a mountain cave
nota: Gigante peludo con pies al revés; base para los simios Skunk Ape y Yowie.

prompt_en: boy-sized sprite with a round potbelly, oversized straw hat shading his face, ash-grey skin, backward-turned bare feet, small hands full of pebbles, ash dusting his shoulders
nota: Niño eterno salvadoreño que lanza guijarros y ceniza; comparte cuerpo con el Duende.

prompt_en: pale spectral woman with chalk-white face and skull-like features, clawed hands raised, tattered woven skirt, tangled dark hair with a paper headband, hovering above the ground with mist trailing from her hem
nota: Espíritus de mujeres muertas de parto; rondan encrucijadas al ocaso en grupo.

prompt_en: towering skeletal woman with a skull face and glowing star-points in her eye sockets, visible ribcage, skirt hung with small skulls and bones, long clawed fingers, night sky swirling behind her
nota: Estrellas-demonio: descienden en eclipses; aviso enorme, golpe imparable que se esquiva.

prompt_en: long turquoise-scaled fire serpent with an upturned curling snout, blazing orange flames along its spine and tail, jagged crest, glowing amber eyes, mosaic-like scale pattern, sparks trailing behind
nota: Arma ígnea de Huitzilopochtli; el fuego avisa en línea recta y se esquiva.

prompt_en: giant sloth-like beast standing on hind legs, shaggy rust-red fur, a single large eye in its forehead, a gaping toothy mouth on its belly, huge curved claws, armored hide patches
nota: Piel impenetrable; solo el ombligo es vulnerable y su hedor aturde.

prompt_en: small forest spirit with bright flame-red hair, moss-green skin with leaf patterns, feet pointing backwards, wild grin, vines wrapped around the waist, standing among tall rainforest trees
nota: Guardián del bosque: sus pies al revés dejan rastros falsos que desvían a Akira.

prompt_en: pink Amazon river dolphin with a long snout and rosy mottled skin, a white wide-brimmed hat covering its blowhole and a small white linen jacket, rising from dark river water
nota: Delfín rosado que de noche toma forma humana con sombrero; trato respetuoso.

prompt_en: huge serpent whose body glows with orange-white flame, two enormous round luminous eyes like lanterns, translucent scales showing embers inside, trailing smoke and sparks across a night field
nota: Serpiente de fuego guardiana de los campos; castiga a quien quema el monte.

prompt_en: river mermaid with long dark hair crowned with water lilies, iridescent blue-green scales covering her torso and tail, a shell necklace, mouth open in song above a calm river at dusk
nota: Su canto hechiza desde el agua; el aviso es la melodía, no el golpe.

prompt_en: old hag-like witch with an alligator head, scaly green snout with crooked teeth, tattered shawl and patchwork dress, long clawed hands, hunched back, carrying a cloth sack over her shoulder
nota: Bruja con cabeza de caimán que asusta a los niños; invoca y maldice a otros.

prompt_en: gaunt wolf-like beast on all fours with shaggy grey-black fur, long snout, glowing green eyes, ragged ears, powerful shoulders, clawed paws, standing in moonlit pampas grass
nota: Séptimo hijo varón convertido en lobo los viernes de noche; rápido y esquivo.

prompt_en: short stocky hairy man-spirit about waist-high, oversized hands and feet, shaggy dark fur covering his body, wide-brimmed straw hat, glowing eyes, holding a rolled tobacco leaf, crouched at a forest edge
nota: Duende guaraní nocturno que silba; se apacigua con ofrendas de tabaco y miel.

prompt_en: emaciated wolf-like beast on all fours with ash-pale fur, exposed ribs, bone-white mask-like face, hollow glowing eyes, tattered burial cloth around its neck, prowling between old gravestones
nota: Hijo maldito guaraní asociado a la muerte; mismo cuerpo que el Lobizón, otra paleta.

prompt_en: huge lizard-bodied beast with seven snarling dog heads on thick necks, rough mottled brown-green scales, glowing orange eyes, clawed lizard legs and a thick tail, cave mouth behind
nota: Siete cabezas de perro: cada una avisa distinto y se corta por separado.

prompt_en: giant serpent with a bright red-and-green parrot head, hooked beak and forked tongue, thick coiling green scaly body marked with yellow bands, rising from marsh water
nota: Serpiente con cabeza de loro; su chillido es el aviso y protege los esteros.

prompt_en: stocky pack beast with a thick coat of coarse dark wool, curved ram-like horns, powerful clawed paws, a long fanged snout and glowing yellow eyes, snarling in a moonlit forest
nota: Dudosa: bestia guaraní de manada; aspecto exacto sin confirmar, tomado como carnero feroz.

prompt_en: small blond forest dwarf with shoulder-length golden hair, a tattered straw hat, a glowing golden staff, mischievous smile, standing in a patch of midday sunlight among trees
nota: Aparece en la siesta con su bastón de oro; su silbido hechiza.

prompt_en: lean forest guardian with weathered bark-like skin, one normal bare foot and one twisted hoof-like foot, moss in his hair, green glowing eyes, vines wrapping his arms, among giant jungle trees
nota: Imita a un conocido; se delata por un pie deforme: la copia falsa no daña.

prompt_en: colossal moss-covered anaconda-like serpent lying like a fallen log, bark-textured scales with ferns and small trees growing along its back, large hypnotic amber eyes, broad head

prompt_en: colossal anaconda-like serpent with blue-black scales and a silvery belly, broad flat head with pale glowing eyes, dripping river weeds, a swirling whirlpool around its coils on a dark jungle lake

prompt_en: black mule breathing flames, glowing red eyes, mane of embers, broken bridle with jingling silver bells, hooves leaving burning prints, a faint pale woman's face in the smoke

prompt_en: gaunt tall figure in a long dark cloak and wide-brimmed hat, face hidden in shadow, long thin fingers holding a curved knife and a clay jar, lurking on a mountain trail

prompt_en: gaunt underworld lord in a dark woven poncho and a tall crown of black stone shards, ash-grey skin, glowing red eyes, holding a flickering miner's lamp in a lightless stone tunnel
nota: Señor del inframundo andino; los mineros aún lo veneran: PNJ o jefe respetuoso.

prompt_en: two-headed winged serpent with a llama-like head at one end and a fox-like fanged head at the other, shimmering fish scales, condor wings, long coiling body, glacial lake mist
nota: Dragón-serpiente andino de varios animales; ataca con sus dos cabezas alternando.

prompt_en: small hunched goblin-like mountain spirit with wrinkled grey skin, oversized head, long white beard, glowing pale eyes, gnarled hands, wrapped in a tattered cloak, crouching at a dark cave mouth
nota: Dudosa: espíritu andino maligno de cuevas, probablemente un duende; aspecto sin confirmar.

prompt_en: spotted grey mountain cat with luminous green eyes that flash lightning, frost-coated whiskers, hail pellets swirling around its shoulders, long tufted tail, perched on a cold rocky peak
nota: Gato de tormenta andino: sus ojos lanzan rayos y trae granizo.

prompt_en: river guardian spirit with long flowing hair of green water weeds, pale blue-grey skin, a fish-like tail, eyes glowing like moonlit water, surrounded by lily pads and gentle whirlpools
nota: Categoría de espíritus de río; relleno que protege el agua y maldice a intrusos.

prompt_en: small shaggy forest sprite with leaf-green markings riding a white-lipped peccary, holding a twisted vine staff, wild red hair, glowing eyes, surrounded by jungle foliage

prompt_en: gaunt towering humanoid with emaciated grey skin stretched over bones, antlered skull-like head, sunken glowing eyes, long clawed fingers, frost clinging to ragged fur, standing in snowy pines

prompt_en: enormous raptor-like bird with a lake-wide wingspan, dark storm-blue and white feathers, glowing yellow eyes, a sharp hooked beak, crackling arcs of lightning between its wing feathers, black storm clouds

prompt_en: huge horned serpent with iridescent scales marked by seven dark spots, branching antlers, a glittering crystal set in its forehead, rattlesnake-like tail, coiled in a mountain pool

prompt_en: huge lynx-like water cat with copper-green scales along its back and tail, a row of spiky dorsal spines, small curved horns, long serpentine tail, glowing amber eyes, emerging from a dark lake

prompt_en: dark blue-black panther-like beast with small curved horns, copper-colored claws and mane, spiked back, long serpent tail, glowing white eyes, half-submerged in swirling lake water

prompt_en: large river serpent with a pair of branching antlers, dark olive-green and copper scales, pale belly, long thin tail, golden eyes, rising from a murky river

prompt_en: towering humanoid giant armored in rough grey flint plates like a stone coat, hulking shoulders, heavy brow, glowing pale eyes, boulder-like fists, standing among rocky crags
nota: Gigante de coraza pétrea: cada placa se rompe con un corte preciso.

prompt_en: gaunt towering ice giant with pale blue skin cracked like frozen ground, frost crystals on its shoulders, a heart of ice glowing in its chest, tattered white fur, long icicle claws
nota: Versión micmac del Wendigo: gigante de hielo; su corazón helado es el punto débil.

prompt_en: graceful spirit shaped like a woman with deer legs ending in hooves, long dark hair threaded with leaves, small antler-like twigs on her brow, a flowing woven dress, amber eyes
nota: Hoy simboliza justicia por mujeres indígenas; tratar con respeto, nunca como villana gratuita.

prompt_en: huge disembodied head with wild streaming grey hair, hollow glowing eyes, a wide fanged mouth, small clawed hands growing from its jaw, floating above a night forest
nota: Cabeza voladora iroquesa; embiste en picado y se retira; aviso corto.

prompt_en: large lizard-like beast with a heavy scaly body, broad head with powerful fanged jaws, thick clawed limbs, dust-brown ridged hide, standing in dry scrubland

prompt_en: oversized jackrabbit with long ears and a pair of small antelope-like horns, tawny brown fur, white belly, alert dark eyes, powerful hind legs ready to bound across prairie grass
nota: Broma de taxidermista de Wyoming (años treinta); veloz y esquivo, imita voces humanas.

prompt_en: tall shaggy ape-man covered in matted reddish-brown fur, broad shoulders, long arms, flat dark face with glowing eyes, faint green fumes rising from its coat, wading through a swamp
nota: Simio de los pantanos de Florida; su hedor es un área de veneno.

prompt_en: large amphibious beast with a shaggy dark seal-like body, dog-like head with walrus tusks, flipper-like limbs, horse-like tail, glowing eyes, emerging from a swamp billabong at night
nota: Monstruo aborigen de pantanos con descripciones muy variadas; emerge del agua y arrastra.

prompt_en: small bright-crimson imp about one meter tall with an oversized head, a huge toothless mouth, suction-cup fingertips and toes, hanging upside-down from a fig tree branch
nota: Diablillo carmesí de las higueras: se deja caer sobre el viandante desde arriba.

prompt_en: hairy merman-like water monster with a long fish tail, webbed clawed hands, a fanged face framed by tangled river-weed hair, murky green scales, rising from a wide lake
nota: Dudosa: ser acuático ngarrindjeri parecido al Bunyip; forma exacta sin confirmar.

prompt_en: tall shaggy ape-man covered in coarse grey-brown fur, heavy brow, deep-set glowing eyes, broad shoulders, long arms, large leathery hands, standing among eucalyptus trees at dusk
nota: Hombre-simio del monte australiano; mismo cuerpo que el Sisimite con otra paleta.

prompt_en: enormous serpent whose scales shimmer in every color of the rainbow, arching over a waterhole like a rainbow, calm wise eyes, coiling through red desert rocks and clouds
nota: Ser creador sagrado de pueblos aborígenes: solo lore o PNJ, jamás enemigo.

prompt_en: colossal bloated green-brown frog with a swollen belly full of water, wide mouth, bulging golden eyes, warty skin dripping, squatting in a dried-up lake bed
nota: Rana que bebió toda el agua; hacerla reír la obliga a devolverla.

prompt_en: long-bodied river dragon with sleek dark green-grey scales, a ridge of spine plates, a broad flat head with tusk-like teeth, glowing pale eyes, rising from a deep river pool
nota: Guardián de ríos y cuevas maorí; no todos son hostiles, usar con respeto.

prompt_en: colossal octopus with deep red-purple skin, eight thick tentacles lined with suckers lifting a towering wave, huge glowing eyes, a hooked beak, rising from a stormy sea
nota: Pulpo gigante que Kupe persiguió por el mar; mismo cuerpo que el Kraken.

prompt_en: slender ethereal forest spirit with pale shimmering skin and long red-gold hair, grey-white cloak woven from mist, a bone flute at its lips, standing in misty ferns on a mountain ridge
nota: Seres de la niebla que huyen del sol y del fuego; su flauta desorienta.

prompt_en: merman with grey-blue skin, gill slits along the neck, a shark-like tail and dorsal fin, sharp teeth, a long barbed spear, riding a shimmering rainbow ray above the waves
nota: Hombre-pez malévolo de las islas Salomón; se dice que viaja por arcoíris.

prompt_en: giant water lizard with glossy dark-green scales, a ridged back, long tail, a wide crocodilian head with golden eyes, claws gripping the edge of a spring pool, ferns around
nota: Lagarto guardián de manantiales hawaiano; algunos son ancestros venerados, tratar con respeto.

prompt_en: large nocturnal bird with a plump body, wings shimmering with gold and silver metallic light, a bright curved beak, strong running legs, racing across dark desert rocks leaving a luminous trail
nota: Ave de Atacama: su luz de oro y plata guía o pierde al minero.

prompt_en: slender white unicorn-like horse with a long spiral ivory horn glowing softly, silver mane, cloven hooves, calm blue eyes, standing in a misty forest clearing
nota: Dudosa: en origen es el cuerno del unicornio; aquí se toma como unicornio curativo.

prompt_en: muscular warrior with a single large eye in the center of his forehead, fur-trimmed leather armor, braided beard, a long spear, gold-flecked belt, standing on a rocky mountain slope
nota: Guerrero legendario de un solo ojo que roba oro a los grifos.

prompt_en: headless humanoid warrior with eyes, nose and mouth set directly in his broad chest, thick shoulders, leather shoulder straps and kilt, crude wooden club, standing in a dusty desert
nota: Cara en el pecho: el único blanco real es el torso; golpear arriba no sirve.

prompt_en: heavy buffalo-bodied beast with a huge hog-like head too heavy to lift, hanging low to the ground, shaggy mane covering the eyes, scaly belly, short thick legs, murky green breath

prompt_en: hybrid beast with a stag-like body, lion haunches, horse hooves, a badger-like head, a gaping mouth stretching ear to ear filled with one ridge of bone instead of teeth, tawny striped coat
nota: Imita voces humanas para atraer viajeros; su dentadura es un solo hueso.

prompt_en: hippo-sized black beast with a boar-like tusked jaw, elephant tail, goat-like body and two long movable horns swiveling independently, one forward and one back, shaggy flanks, small fierce eyes
nota: Sus cuernos giran de forma independiente; el aviso depende de hacia dónde apuntan.

prompt_en: heraldic beast with a russet fox head, golden eagle talons for forelegs, a grey greyhound chest, a tawny lion body, and a grey wolf's hind legs with a bushy tail
nota: Emblema heráldico del clan O'Kelly; cinco animales en un cuerpo veloz.

prompt_en: large shaggy beast, a cross between a wolf and a big cat, dark fur streaked with grey, glowing yellow eyes, thick tail, powerful paws, lurking among autumn woods
nota: Dudosa: críptido estadounidense de aspecto incierto; se asume gran felino-lobo oscuro.

prompt_en: stout horse-bodied beast with a stag's head, elephant-like feet, a boar's tail and a single straight black horn, dark brown hide, fierce eyes, bellowing in a forest glade
nota: Bestia de Plinio: cabeza de ciervo, pies de elefante, cola de jabalí, un cuerno negro.

prompt_en: enormous dark-scaled serpent coiled into a perfect circle biting its own tail, gold-edged belly scales, glowing amber eyes, faint alchemical glyphs along its body, mist inside the ring
nota: Serpiente circular: el punto débil está donde la boca muerde la cola.

prompt_en: large shaggy beast covered in coarse green-grey fur and spiny quills, a tortoise-like shell on its back, clawed paws, a snake-like head and a long scaly tail
nota: Dudosa: parece la Peluda francesa (la Velue); el «de Culle» no está confirmado.

prompt_en: serpent-headed beast with a leopard-spotted body, lion haunches, deer hooves, a long sinuous neck, belly rippling as if hounds bark inside, lean powerful frame, green-gold eyes
nota: Cabeza de serpiente y ladridos en el vientre; el sonido avisa de su carga.

prompt_en: small lizard-like salamander with glossy black skin marked by glowing orange stripes, ember-like eyes, wisps of smoke rising from its back, short clawed legs, resting in a bed of red-hot coals
nota: Vive en las brasas y apaga fuegos con su frío; su veneno contamina el agua.

prompt_en: giant sea centipede with a long armored reddish-brown segmented body, dozens of paddle-like legs, curved venomous pincer jaws, trailing antennae, spiny ridges, thrashing out of dark ocean waves
nota: Ciempiés marino de bestiarios antiguos; sale de las olas y se lanza sobre botes.
